unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Reviewed kana evidence is not yet consumed by both speech turns and typed answers
unresolvedPublicationFindings.current: The reviewed reading sheet is off-schema. RolePlayStep passes acceptedAnswers only for turn one, and its second-turn required tokens come only from canonical cloze answers. ComplicationStep and TypeRecallStep accept only explicitly integrated acceptedAnswers; the CJK checker removes spaces but cannot convert kanji/kana.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: If these drafts were published with a canonical-only adapter, correct kana-only input or ASR could be rejected, including the second spoken reply. Text-level reading approval alone does not prove runtime acceptance.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.concreteFix: Before publication, implement and independently test a reviewed-sidecar adapter for canonical plus exact authored kana cloze/recall answers and both spoken replies, and honor reviewed token-pair alternatives where token scoring is used. Keep canonical TTS surfaces single-counted and keep current recording/scoring settings pending the measured pilot. This is deferred integration work, not a change requested to the approved canonical audio text.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Exercise canonical, unspaced kana and reviewed alternative-kanji input on both role-play turns and every typed answer in the real Japanese B1 fixture.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: German-only pattern headings remain visible to English-base learners
unresolvedPublicationFindings.current: All 20 pattern.label values contain German explanatory headings. PatternStep prints pattern.label directly, and collectGuidedBaseFields visits only objects, so a bare string label is not localized by a generated base edition.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: English-base learners receive an untranslated German heading even though rule and example translations are available in English.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.concreteFix: Before publication, supply an approved locale-aware pattern-label mapping, or exact bilingual labels in the existing string field as already done for form cues. Keep source status draft until the chosen publication path is tested.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Render all pattern labels with German and English base preferences and confirm each heading is understandable. Label edits do not alter the canonical spoken surfaces.

scope: Exact canonical spoken text for local TTS only. Full kana sidecar is review evidence, never additional synthesized inventory. Complete nonspoken findings remain publication holds; no human-native, listening or publication approval.

rawReview.scope: Personally read every authored field of the exact reviewed P1/P2 files and every reading-sheet field. App read-only; only the two assigned scratch reports written. No database, provider, paid call, git operation, audio generation or publication.

exactReplay.method: Loaded original JSON; asserted every oldValue, applied each newValue in memory, deep-compared all three complete resulting objects to reviewed files. Original and applied hash ledgers match actual bytes.

frozenBoundaries.method: Imported actual GUIDED_LESSONS and compared all Japanese trophies under NFC/casefold with the full spec.

actualOfflineGate.warnings: Ten manual-staging warnings per path only; engineering approval is separately REWORK.

checks.nativeJapanese: No issue: natural polite adult-peer main clauses, licensed subordinate plain forms, attached particles/copulas, kanji numerals and complete native units. P2 L2's revised concession and P1 L7's revised timeline are coherent.
checks.fourTurnEpisodes: No issue: all follow-ups add a question or constraint, and all second replies continue it. P1 L9 answers the change question through いいえ and their familiar shared laughter; compressed but coherent. No staff-only outcome asserted by a learner.
checks.staging: No issue: P1 L1-3 te chains, L4-6 past ongoing/toki/tara, L7-10 node/te-kara; P2 L1-2 opinion/concession, exact amended tashikani frame in L3, shi/temo/demo L4-6, hedge/opinion reservation L7-10. Recognition-only interlocutor material was not misclassified as learner production.
checks.visibleConstraints: No issue for offered alternatives: ComplicationStep shows both the follow-up translation and every bilingual form cue. Those cues expressly require kedo, ga, kamoshiremasen, te-link or affirmative/past forms, so otherwise grammatical different forms are excluded without relying on hidden dialogue[3].baseText. Build shows the first-reply translation and uses exact string order. Personally checked every offered distractor/fallback and the four-chip groupings for a same-meaning alternative; none found.
checks.baseTexts: No issue in German/English sentence meanings and explanations. German-only pattern labels are a publication finding below.
checks.readings: No issue in all 460 rows: lexical readings, particles は/へ, katakana loanwords, gemination, number readings, correspondence, spacing and punctuation checked personally. All 60 token pairs match their first-reply unit; all 40 trophy surfaces obey exact closed tails. No automatic kana generation or human accent certification claimed.
checks.trophies: No issue: lexical trophies are naturally anchored by the recorded exact whole unit and permitted remainder; 急に and 確かに are intact lexicalized adverbs. Frozen A1/A2 content untouched.
checks.visualVerification: Not run: this is a scratch-content and static renderer review, with no integrated Japanese B1 runtime lesson.
